`fast-parse` is still pinned at `1.4.2` in `package.json` — the version `NOTES.md` says was yanked for a prototype-pollution bug. `date-fmt`, `pg-lite`, and `redis-min` are all fine as noted.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, worst first:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — no auth on the internal routes, open to the internet since the VPN was retired.
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL built by string concatenation in the saved-report filter and sort.
3. **`config/staging.js`** — plaintext staging database password committed to the repo.
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` still on the yanked `1.4.2`, needs `1.4.3`.

No service files were touched — only `AUDIT.md` was added.
